hero.title: Products & Services
hero.description: Delta Seikan provides comprehensive metal packaging solutions, from 2-piece and 3-piece aluminum cans to high-tech coating services, meeting the strictest food industry standards.

trangPhu.title: Metal Coating Service
trangPhu.desc: Delta Seikan provides metal coating services with modern technology from KBA - LTG (Germany), ensuring high adhesion, superior corrosion resistance, and food safety. Products meet strict international standards such as BPA-NI, PFAS-free, suitable for the food and beverage industry.

lon2manh.title: 2-Piece Cans – DRD Technology
lon2manh.desc: 2-piece cans (DRD – Drawn & Redrawn) are manufactured using advanced deep-drawing technology, optimizing mechanical strength, minimizing seams, and ensuring absolute airtightness. Suitable for canned food, providing high preservation efficiency and production cost optimization.

lon3manh.title: 3-Piece Cans
lon3manh.desc: 3-piece cans consist of body, bottom, and lid, joined by modern welding technology, ensuring high tightness and durability. Flexible solutions in size and capacity, suitable for many products from food to industrial chemicals.

napEOE.title: EOE Lids (Easy Open End)
napEOE.desc: Easy-open end lids (EOE) provide maximum convenience for consumers. Manufactured from high-quality materials, ensuring absolute airtightness and easy opening without tools.

dichVu.title: Packaging & Distribution Solutions
dichVu.desc: Delta Seikan provides comprehensive packaging and distribution solutions, optimizing the supply chain, enhancing operational efficiency, and ensuring product quality throughout storage and transport.
dichVu.i1Desc: Strict control process, ensuring product quality and safety.
dichVu.i2Desc: Flexible design, easy to integrate into production systems.
dichVu.i3Desc: Solutions aimed at minimizing environmental impact.
